Priya Varma: Quick sync — I sketched a lean mapping + handshake for partner systems (marketplace -> SI -> customer). Goal: clarify lead routing, account stitching (IDs), and Joint Announcement gating. Can we agree on a golden-path?
Alex Chen: Love it. A couple quick asks: add `region`, `account_tier`, `SI_priority`, and `legal_status` columns. Also propose a 72h claim SLA for inbound leads. :+1:
Tom Bowers: For cloud marketplace leads: if `SI_priority` is high, route to SI queue first, otherwise marketplace SDR owns initial outreach. We should include `marketplace_listing_id` -> `sfdc_account_id` mapping.
Leah (partner-ops): From ops POV: +1 on 72h SLA and add a weekly sweep job to catch unclaimed leads. Also require an NDA check flag before joint announce.
Priya Varma: Added a first-pass template here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/cp/ABcD1234 — pasted quick CSV header below for visibility.
```
marketplace_listing_id,sfdc_account_id,company_name,region,account_tier,SI_priority,legal_status,note,initial_lead_ts,claimed_by
```
Tom Bowers: That header looks good. Suggest we also add `preferred_contact_method` and `partner_hw_bundled` (boolean) for hardware deals.
Alex Chen: Operational decision: claims should be done in SFDC using a `Partner Claim` record type so fulfillment and commissions track. We should create a simple Playbook doc with: 1) claim flow, 2) escalation path (48h), 3) joint announce checklist.
Leah (partner-ops): Checklist items (quick): NDA signed, marketing coord lead, press embargo window, co-brand assets, support contact mapped. I'll draft the checklist.
Priya Varma: Can we decide on the announcement window? My suggestion: announce with SI only after legal_status == "ok" and 14-day embargo ready. Thoughts?
Alex Chen: 14-day window feels safe for complex deals. For smaller hardware bundles, allow 7-day with PartnerOps signoff.
Tom Bowers: Technical handoff: include infra owner contact + required baseline documentation (runbook, expected QPS). Put a small template in the doc.
Leah (partner-ops): I'll add enforcement rules: claims older than 72h -> auto-escalate to partnerships team; unclaimed >7d -> auto-close and notify marketplace owner. PartnerBot will post weekly sweep reminders. :robot_face:
PartnerBot: Weekly partner-sweep scheduled. Next run: in 2 days. Reminders will ping #partnerships.
Priya Varma: Great — I'll update the mapping sheet and spin up the one-pager Playbook. Want volunteers to review: @Alex @Tom @Leah — can you skim before EOD tomorrow?
Alex Chen: On it.
Tom Bowers: Got it, will review.
Leah (partner-ops): Will review and add ops items.
Priya Varma: Thanks all — will post final draft and tag legal/marketing for the joint announce gating. :tada:
